start.label: Start
start.description: Entry point of the process. Inputs and connections are defined in the process settings.

note.label: Comment
note.description: A comment on the canvas. Not executed.

http.label: API call
http.description: Call an endpoint of a connected platform. Writes (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) are skipped in dry runs. Connect the "error" output to handle failures instead of stopping the run.

mutating.label: Treat as write (skip in dry run)

set.label: Set variables
set.description: Compute values with JSONata expressions and store them in vars.<name>.

forEach.label: For each
forEach.description: Runs the nodes connected to "each item" once per item (the item is vars.<as>), then continues with "done". Leave the last node of the loop body unconnected.

concurrency.label: Parallel items (1 = one after another)
concurrency.help: Up to 20. In parallel mode variables set inside the loop are local to each item; the loop result (Save result as) holds them per item in results[].

if.label: If / else
if.description: Continues with "true" or "false" depending on a condition.

userTask.label: User task / approval
userTask.description: Pause the run and ask a person to pick items from a list (select) or approve/reject (approve, with "approved" and "rejected" outputs – an unconnected "rejected" output fails the run). The decision is recorded in the protocol.

assignees.label: Who may decide
assignees.help: Users, teams or roles. Empty = everyone allowed to run or approve this process.

fourEyes.label: Four-eyes: the person who started the run may not decide

check.label: Check / assertion
check.description: Record a pass/fail check result (status tests, health checks).

failRun.label: Fail the run when the check fails

log.label: Log message
log.description: Write a message (and optional data) to the run protocol.

report.label: Report section
report.description: Add a section with text and/or a table to the run protocol.

browser.label: Browser automation
browser.description: Drive a real browser (Playwright): open pages, fill forms, click, extract text and take screenshots as evidence. The browser session is shared by all browser steps of a run.

publish.label: Publish to dashboard
publish.description: Store a snapshot of rows (with a status per row) and metric values in a dataset for dashboards. Each run replaces the rows; metrics are kept as history for trends. Dashboards read the stored data – they never call the platforms themselves.

columns.label: Columns (keep only what the dashboard needs)

metrics.label: Metrics (name → number expression)
metrics.help: Appended to the history for trend charts

subprocess.label: Run sub-process
subprocess.description: Runs another process as one step (reusable building blocks). The child run gets its own protocol, linked to this run; its outputs (process setting "Outputs") become this node's result. Connect "error" to handle a failed child run.

wait.label: Wait
wait.description: Pause for a number of seconds.

fail.label: Fail run
fail.description: Stop the run with an error message.

portHelp.out: Continues here when the node has finished.
portHelp.error: Taken when the node fails. If unconnected, the run fails (unless “On error” is continue).
portHelp.true: Taken when the condition is true.
portHelp.false: Taken when the condition is false.
portHelp.each: Runs once per item. Leave the last node of the loop body unconnected – the loop then continues with the next item.
portHelp.done: Continues here after all items were processed.
portHelp.approved: Taken when the task is approved (also when the node is skipped).
portHelp.rejected: Taken when the task is rejected. If unconnected, a rejection fails the run.

palette.hint: Drag onto the canvas or click to add.

node.parallelHint: Up to {{count}} items run at the same time

flow.copied_one: {{count}} node copied – paste with {{key}}, also in another process
flow.copied_other: {{count}} nodes copied – paste with {{key}}, also in another process
flow.readOnlyHint: Read-only: select a node to see its configuration.
flow.editHint: Select a node to edit it. Drag from an output (right) to an input (left) to connect nodes. Select a wire or node and press Delete to remove it. {{copy}} / {{paste}} copy and paste selected nodes; {{undo}} undoes.
flow.runHint: The run starts at the Start node and follows the wires. Where one output has several wires, they run one after another, top to bottom.

exprHelp.title: Expression & template help
exprHelp.p1: Expressions use JSONata. Template fields accept {{placeholder}} placeholders; a field that is exactly one placeholder keeps the raw value (list, object, number).
exprHelp.p2: Start typing (or press <c>Ctrl+Space</c>) for suggestions; the value below a field is a live preview using the latest run. Scope: <c>inputs.*</c> run inputs · <c>vars.*</c> node results (saveAs, set, loop items) · <c>const.*</c> constants · <c>run.id / run.dryRun / run.actor</c> · <slotvars/> platform variables.
exprHelp.p3: Inside filters <c>[...]</c> the context is the current item – use <c>$inputs</c>, <c>$vars</c>, <c>$const</c> there, e.g. <c>{{example}}</c>. Append <c>[]</c> to always get a list.
exprHelp.p4: Helpers: <c>$daysSince(ts)</c> <c>$daysAgo(n)</c> <c>$ts(value)</c> <c>$uuid()</c> <c>$pvar(slot, name, default)</c> <c>$secret(slot, key)</c> (value is redacted in logs) plus all JSONata functions ($count, $join, $filter, $lookup, $distinct, …).
exprHelp.p5: Per-item fields (columns, preselect) are evaluated against the item itself: <c>userName</c>, <c>$item</c>.

form.idUsed: Id already used by another node
form.startHint: Inputs (asked when a run starts) and connection slots (which platforms the process uses) are defined in the Settings tab.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Shown on the canvas and in protocols

fields.declareConnections: Declare connections in the “Settings” tab first
fields.jsonHint: JSON or YAML. Strings may contain {{exprs}}.
fields.columnsHint: Value is an expression evaluated against each item (e.g. {{example}}).
fields.processHint: The process to run as one step

paginate.label: Pagination
paginate.hint: Fetch all pages and return the combined items as body
paginate.page: Page number (page / size, e.g. Asset Management)

actions.label: Actions
actions.hint: Playwright selectors: {{selectors}}. Values may contain {{exprs}}, e.g. {{example}}.

inspector.saveFirst: Save the process and run it to inspect nodes.
inspector.noRun: No run yet – run the process (dry run) to see what this node did.
inspector.didNotRun: This node did not run in the latest run.
inspector.varsUnavailable: Variables before the node are not available on this server.

sub.choose: Choose a process to fill in its inputs and connections.
sub.loadFailed: Could not load the chosen process: {{error}}
sub.loadFailedVersion: Could not load the chosen process (v{{version}}): {{error}}
sub.inputsHint: Values passed to the child run. Templates are evaluated in this process. Empty = child default.
sub.unknownInput: Not an input of this process – ignored
sub.connectionsHint: Which of this process' connections the child uses. Empty = same slot name.
sub.returns: The child returns <outputs/> – set “Save result as” to use them.
sub.noOutputs: The child process declares no outputs (Settings → Outputs).

general.name: Name
general.descriptionHint: Explain what the process does, prerequisites and caveats. Shown when starting a run.

inputs.hint: Inputs are asked when a run is started (or stored in a schedule) and available as <path/>.
inputs.name: Name
inputs.label: Label

connections.hint: Connection slots keep the process platform-agnostic: steps refer to a slot (e.g. <c>hub</c>) and the actual platform is chosen when the run starts. Optionally restrict a slot to a platform kind.

constants.notMapping: Constants must be a mapping (key: value)
constants.hint: Static configuration available as <c>const.*</c> (or <c>$const</c> in filters), e.g. group bundles for onboarding. YAML or JSON.

source.hint: The complete process definition as YAML (nodes + wires). You can also paste the compact sequential format (<c>steps:</c> with nested loops and branches) – it is converted into a flow. Click “Apply to editor”, then save to create a new version.

versions.hint: Every save creates a new immutable version. Runs record the exact version and its hash.
versions.author: Author
versions.title: Version v{{version}}

outputs.hint: Values returned when this process runs as a sub-process. Each value is an expression evaluated when the run ends, e.g. <example/>. The parent gets them as the node result (<path/>).
outputs.name: Output name

page.viewOnly: You may view but not change this process
page.restored: Version v{{version}} loaded as working copy – save to make it the current version.
page.unsavedText: Runs always use a saved version. Your current changes are not saved yet – the run would use v{{version}}.

save.title: Save new version
save.commentHint: Recorded with the version and in the audit log

validation.unknownConnection: Unknown connection “{{slot}}”. Declare it under Connections.
validation.unknownSubprocessConnection: Unknown connection “{{slot}}” for sub-process slot “{{childSlot}}”. Declare it under Connections.
validation.whenOnIf: “Only run when” is not supported on if nodes – put it into the condition
validation.invalidOutputName: Invalid output name “{{name}}” (letters, digits and _ only)
validation.startCount: A process needs exactly one start node (found {{count}})
validation.cycle: Wires form a cycle ({{cycle}}). Use a “For each” node for loops.
validation.unreachable: “{{name}}” is not connected to the start node and will never run

diff.onlyOne: Only one version so far – nothing to compare yet.

api.kindHint: Platforms of kind {{kind}} (with an imported API spec)
api.anyHint: Any platform with an imported API spec
api.title: API operation
api.notInSpec: not found in the selected platform’s specs.
api.noSpecPlatform: no platform with a spec to look it up.
api.noSpec: This platform has no API specification yet. Upload one on the platform page (tab “API specs”).
api.methodDiffers: The node uses {{node}} but the operation is {{op}}.
api.pathEdited: The path was edited by hand and no longer matches <path>{{path}}</path>. Editing a path parameter below rebuilds it.

functions.daysSince: Days since a timestamp (ISO or epoch). Empty → undefined.
functions.daysAgo: ISO timestamp n days in the past.
functions.ts: Parse a timestamp into epoch milliseconds.
functions.pvar: Platform variable of a connection slot.
functions.secret: Secret of a connection slot (redacted in logs).
functions.split: Split a string into a list.
functions.exists: true if the value is defined.
functions.contains: true if the string contains the pattern.
functions.reduce: Fold a list into one value.

expr.keys: ↑↓ to choose · Enter/Tab to insert · Esc to close
expr.saveToPreview: Save the process to preview values.
expr.previewUnavailable: Live preview is not available on this server.
expr.noRun: No run yet – run the process (dry run) to preview with data
